title: Monthly ledger export — /ledger/{YYYY}-{MM}.json
description:
The published monthly ledger export (FS-07 §6.2). Immutable once written: regeneration may only re-emit byte-identical content for a locked month, and a divergence is an alert, not a fix (FS07-051). The `.csv` twin carries the same rows flat; the human ledger page generates from the same rows, and any divergence between page, JSON and CSV is a defect (VS-37, ENG-043/044).

The shadow section, when present, carries its label IN BAND so no downstream consumer can strip it accidentally: contributor votes are computed and NOT used for routing until the fairness-review gate opens (D27, FS07-052).

Display law: pages generate exclusively from these rows; per-contributor money respects the published materiality floor; unclaimed shares appear in aggregate only; there are no leaderboards (FS07-052, D15).

At P-M2 there are no allocation rows and no `policy`/`totals` allocation figures — the export carries intake rows only, and before the first money moves the ledger page says 'no money has moved yet' in words rather than rendering a zero (FS07-100, VS-37).

x-psn.producer: index-build (P-M2: index-build-lite CI, VS-04) from the committed monthly table

currency.description: Reporting currency (CHF). Per-row native currency and captured FX travel on the rows.

locked.description: True once the month is locked and the file is immutable. An open month may still receive intake rows.

policy.description: The allocation policy in force for the month. ABSENT at P-M2 — no allocation runs before P-M3, so publishing a policy block would describe machinery that has not acted.

totals.description: Month totals in minor units of `currency`. At P-M2 only `pool` is meaningful; the allocation totals arrive with the allocator at P-M3.

rows.description: The month's rows in canonical order. Row shape is the published ledger-row contract; this export requires the subset every public consumer needs and permits the full row.

label.description: The in-band label, carried so it cannot be stripped by a consumer. Canonical text: 'SHADOW DATA — contributor votes computed, NOT used for routing (D27)'.

contributorRef.description: Login at emission; replaced with an irreversible node_id hash on account deletion (FS07-043). Money rows never reference persons (ENG-083).

headHash.description: Global chain head after this month's last row.

prevHeadHash.description: Global chain head before this month's first row. Genesis is 64 zeros.

monthDigest.description: Digest over this month's rows, mirrored in the chain document and in the month-lock row.

methodologyUrl.description: The published methodology: levy cap, the M+1 hold, the append-only doctrine, and annotation-never-restatement (VS-37).

payerName.description: Opted-in payer name, or the literal `unnamed`.
